PART A (26 of 30 tokens): the settled address-PRE add/lwz-vs-addi/lwzx family; closed by law plus a prior four-variant cap; do not reopen without a genuinely new mechanism. PART B (the 2 surplus instructions at @5d8): the target's stream keeps `lwz sLastPlayerStart / li r21,0 / cmpwi r0,0 / mulli r0,r21,12` -- and the `mulli` on a register just loaded with the constant 0 is the decisive detail this session added: in the TARGET, `selected` was never constant-propagated, whereas in OUR build it provably is (our `selected = 0;` immediately precedes the guard, so our optimizer folds the comparison away before any of the passes the dead-store lever depends on can run). That is why all three forms failed and why the LinkItemTriggers mechanism, which is sound, cannot reach this site: volatile can make the LOADED operand unknown, but nothing portable makes our own constant-initialised local unknown without changing the program. HANDOFF: the next genuinely new axis is not another body shape -- it is to find the source form in which `selected` is NOT a compile-time constant at the guard (e.g. it is the same variable the preceding locator loop wrote, rather than a freshly zeroed one). Five axes are now closed on this cluster across two sessions: empty body, initializer-at-declaration, dead-store body, dead-store + volatile, live body + volatile.
